patches.ryong_changes: Studio RPC over a vendor HID collection (WebHID): hid.h report, hog.c characteristics, usb_hid.c SET_REPORT, studio/hid_rpc_transport.c; rpc.c: all transports always receive and the one a request arrived on answers (zmk_rpc_note_rx); backlight.c: perceptual brightness for PWM LEDs (duty = brightness^2/100, ZMK_BACKLIGHT_PERCEPTUAL); hid_rpc_transport: no peripheral latency while Studio talks over BLE HID (restored after 20 s idle); hid_rpc_transport never keeps references to closed connections; Studio fast mode (HID and GATT) asks for Apple-accepted connection parameters (15-30 ms, latency 0); hog.c: Studio keeps at most 2 BLE reports in the controller (keystrokes always find a buffer) and keyboard/consumer reports wait briefly for a buffer instead of being dropped

zmk-feature-os-detection.ryong_changes: any real reads decide (only an empty fingerprint keeps the stored result); Windows needs Appearance together with a HID read; last fingerprint over Studio; optional host probe (off); BLE side rewritten: per-connection counters, a slot's OS decided at pairing (or by the host's own answer) and kept on reconnects, probe rewritten with watchdog, LL company ID in diagnostics
